GOLD_ALCHEMY.Title: Alchemy Workshop

Button.OpenIngredientsTooltip: Open compendium repository with all alchemical ingredients
Button.OpenPotionsTooltip: Open compendium repository with ready potions and draughts
Button.OpenRecipesTooltip: Open compendium of recipe scrolls and alchemical grimoires
Button.ToggleWorldRecipesTooltip: Toggle view: show all world recipes or only known by character

Details.MinimumTending: at least 3 hours of work each day
Details.WorldTimeMustPass: World time must pass before completion.
Details.NoRecipeSelected: Select a recipe from the list on the left.
Details.IngredientsMissingTooltip: Missing required ingredients or attunement points
Details.CannotBrewTooltip: Cannot brew this potion (missing ingredients, lacking tether points, or unknown recipe).

Errors.NotEnoughCapacity: Not enough attunement capacity! Required: {required}, available: {available}.
Errors.NoDoses: No doses of this potion left!
Errors.InvalidPotion: This potion has no active alchemical tether.
Errors.NotYourPotion: Only the potion's creator can sever its tether.
Errors.RecipeNotKnown: This character does not have access to this recipe.
Errors.BrewAlreadyInProgress: This character already has a brewing process in progress. Complete it or ask the GM to cancel it.
Errors.WorkshopUnavailable: The GM has not enabled the Alchemy Workshop for this character.
Errors.ThrowNotDrink: This potion is not for drinking – throw it at a target (right click → Throw Potion).
Errors.NoThrowTarget: Target a token with the T key before throwing the potion.

Notifications.SelectCharacter: Select a character to open the Alchemy Workshop.
Notifications.BrewStarted: Brewing started. Ready: {date}. Requires at least 3 hours of work each day.
Notifications.BrewFailure: Brewing failed! Ingredients have been lost.
Notifications.TetherRefundNotify: Gold Weave: {drinker} drank {potion}. You regain {points} focus points!
Notifications.PanaceaRestored: Panacea restored {wounds} wounds and cleansed the body!
Notifications.PanaceaUniversalisRestored: Panacea Universalis restored {wounds} wounds, cleansed blood, removed Fatigue and cured all diseases!
Notifications.VitalityDraughtRestored: Vitality draught immediately cleared all Fatigued conditions!
Notifications.DigestiveTonicRestored: Digestive tonic soothed stomach ailments and removed Poisoned condition!
Notifications.FortuneFull: Your Fortune is already at maximum.
Notifications.AlkahestApplied: Al-kahest inflicted severe chemical burns (5 Ablaze conditions)!
Notifications.Antitoxin: The antidote neutralized toxins in your bloodstream.
Notifications.SpringDewHealed: Jade spring dew restored {wounds} wounds and stabilized injuries!
Notifications.Purified: Blood has been cleansed of toxins and poisons.
Notifications.SoulPurified: Mind and soul are filled with radiant calm.
Notifications.Blinded: A blinding flash blinded the target!
Notifications.AblazeApplied: Incendiary fluid set the target ablaze!
Notifications.FellAsleep: Mandrake extract caused the target to fall into deep sleep.
Notifications.WarpstoneCorruption: Warpstone brew contaminated the body with {corruption} Corruption points!
Notifications.AlreadyMemorized: Recipe is already memorized by this character!
Notifications.NoMemorySlotsAvailable: No free memory slots available! Forget another recipe or increase Intelligence / Craft.
Notifications.BookEditGMOnly: Only the GM can change the contents of recipe books.
Notifications.MemorizeFromBookOnly: Recipes can be memorized from an owned book. Adding directly from the list is restricted to the GM.
Notifications.IngredientRequired: Recipe must contain at least one ingredient!
Notifications.GMOnlyAction: This action is only available to the Game Master.
Notifications.SoothingDraught: The soothing draught removed 1 Fatigued Condition.
Notifications.MandrakeResisted: The body fights off the drowsiness – the mandrake has no effect.
Notifications.FellAsleepHours: The mandrake extract puts the drinker to sleep for {hours} hours (Unconscious).
Notifications.ForgetResisted: The mind resists the draught – memories remain.
Notifications.ForgetFailed: Memories of the last day dissolve into fog.
Notifications.TrollrootRegen: For the next days wounds heal twice as fast and broken bones knit in half the time (tracked by the GM).
Notifications.HealingLimit: The body will not take more potion healing this encounter – no effect.
Notifications.HealingDraughtNoEffect: A Healing Draught does not work on a character at 0 Wounds.
Notifications.MarvelousRefused: Vile taste – the drinker cannot swallow it.
Notifications.MarvelousDrunk: Swallowed: 1 Fatigued Condition. Otherwise… nothing happens.
Notifications.PurityCooldown: The soul will not accept another cleansing before a week has passed.
Notifications.SleepComing: In 2–3 hours the drinker falls into a deep sleep for {hours} hours (the GM applies Unconscious).

Chat.IngredientsDestroyed: Ingredients were ruined and wasted in the crucible.
Chat.TetherRefundInfo: {points} Weave points return to the alchemist.
Chat.TetherSevered: {alchemist} has severed the etheric tether with {potion} held by {holder}. {points} attunement points restored.
Chat.TetherSeveredDesc: [Chamon tether was severed by the Alchemist. The potion has lost its magical properties.]
Chat.ThrowMissed: Miss! The flask shatters near the target – the GM decides where it landed and who it caught.
Chat.ThrowFizzled: The spoiled potion shatters with no effect.
Chat.CloudCreated: A cloud covers the area for {rounds} rounds, granting full cover within it.
Chat.ThrownTrollAcid: {target}: troll acid deals {damage} Damage (Penetrating: the GM may ignore 1 AP). {details}
Chat.ThrownSunFlash: {target}: Blinded ×{value}. Daemons and Undead suffer extra Damage at the GM's discretion.
Chat.MagicalReplaced: The Winds clash – no longer active: {names}.

Spoilage.Deactivated: The potion has lost its potency and no longer has an effect.
Spoilage.Fresh: Fresh and stable. Operates at full potency.
Spoilage.CompletelySpoiled: Completely spoiled! The draught has lost its power and causes side effects.
Spoilage.PartiallySpoiled: Partially spoiled! Works, but produces an unpleasant side effect.
Spoilage.MiraclePreserved: Expired, yet miraculously preserved and functional!

FoulBreath.name: Foul Breath
FoulBreath.desc: A stench of rotten eggs wafts from the drinker's mouth. -1 SL to Fellowship tests for 1 day.

Cramps.name: Colic and Cramps
Cramps.desc: Painful abdominal cramps. -1 SL to all Willpower tests for 1 day.

Flatulence.name: Violent Flatulence
Flatulence.desc: Distracting affliction. The character may perform either Move OR Action in a round, not both.

Nausea.name: Nausea and Vomiting
Nausea.desc: Overcome with sickness. On failed movement tests, the character gains the Stunned condition.

Dizziness.name: Dizziness and Dark Spots
Dizziness.desc: Blurred vision and vertigo. -2 SL to Perception and Weapon Skill tests.

GutBurn.name: Gut Burn
GutBurn.desc: Violent acid reflux. The character immediately suffers 1d10 damage ignoring armour!

Poisoning.name: Toxic Poisoning
Poisoning.desc: Spoiled ingredients have turned to venom. The character gains the Poisoned condition.

Deadly.name: Deadly Poison!
Deadly.desc: Extremely lethal decoction. The character gains 2 Poisoned conditions and immediately tests Toughness (-20)!

Disasters.Ruined: Ruined Batch: A contaminated potion smelling of rotting sewage is produced.
Disasters.Smoke: Smoke and Stench: Heavy sulphurous smoke fills the area. For 3 days, the alchemist reeks of brimstone.
Disasters.Clumsy: Clumsy Accident: Apparatus is knocked over and shattered. Repairs cost 5% of laboratory value.
Disasters.Fumes: Acrid Fumes: The alchemist inhales caustic gas and must pass a Toughness (-10) test or gain Poisoned.
Disasters.AcidBurn: Acid Splash: Splashed with burning reagent! Suffers 1d10 damage ignoring armour.
Disasters.MinorBlast: Minor Blast!: Equipment damaged (10% value). The alchemist takes 1d10+2 damage.
Disasters.MajorBlast: Explosion!: Workshop heavily damaged (20% value). The alchemist takes 1d10+4 damage!
Disasters.Fire: Fire!: A raging chemical fire breaks out, destroying 30% of workshop equipment.

IronSkin.Name: Iron Skin
IronSkin.Desc: A draught hardened with Chamon essence, turning flesh to plate steel.
IronSkin.Effect: +2 AP on all locations and −10 Agility for 10 minutes.

LiquidGold.Name: Liquid Gold
LiquidGold.Desc: A sacred drink of the Gold Order filling the soul with pure Gold Weave.

QuicksilverSpeed.Name: Quicksilver Speed
QuicksilverSpeed.Desc: A concoction bestowing swiftness and mercurial reflexes.
QuicksilverSpeed.Effect: +20 I, +10 Ag and +1 Movement for 10 minutes.

LeadFortitude.Name: Lead Fortitude
LeadFortitude.Desc: A heavy leaden decoction steeling the mind against dread.
LeadFortitude.Effect: +10 WP and −10 I for 1 hour; immune to Fear and Terror (GM adjudicates).

ChamonPanacea.Name: Transmutational Panacea of Chamon
ChamonPanacea.Desc: A mystical panacea transmuting broken tissue into whole flesh.
ChamonPanacea.Effect: Instantly restores 2d10 wounds and removes Poisoned and Bleeding.

WeaveEssence.Name: Weave Essence
WeaveEssence.Desc: A decoction opening the wizard's mystical channels.

VitriolAcid.Name: Vitriol Acid
VitriolAcid.Desc: A corrosive mineral acid burning through armor and flesh.
VitriolAcid.Effect: Thrown like an Incendiary: every target hit gains 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions (acid burns).

LeonardPowder.Name: Alchemical Flash Powder
LeonardPowder.Desc: A powder causing a blinding flash and bang, disorienting enemies and disrupting spellcasting.
LeonardPowder.Effect: Blinds all within 3 yards (Blind condition for 1d10 rounds on failed Toughness test) and -20 to casting spells.

PhosphorFire.Name: Phosphor Fire
PhosphorFire.Desc: A pyrophoric incendiary liquid bursting into violent flame.
PhosphorFire.Effect: Incendiary: every target hit gains 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions.

SmellingSalts.Name: Smelling Salts
SmellingSalts.Desc: A sharp ammoniac compound reviving the unconscious.
SmellingSalts.Effect: Instantly revives unconscious actors and removes 1 Stunned condition.

SmokePellet.Name: Smoke Pellet
SmokePellet.Desc: A smoke bomb creating a choking cloud of concealment.
SmokePellet.Effect: A smoke cloud for 1d10 rounds: blocks sight, ranged attacks and magic missiles.

MorrSalve.Name: Morr's Salve
MorrSalve.Desc: A numbing analgesic ointment easing wound pain.
MorrSalve.Effect: Heals TB Wounds and removes 1 Bleeding Condition. One healing potion per encounter.

MandrakeExtract.Name: Mandrake Extract
MandrakeExtract.Desc: A heavy soporific and paralytic fluid.
MandrakeExtract.Effect: Challenging (+0) Endurance Test; on failure deep sleep after 2–3 hours, lasting 1d10+4 hours.

AntitoxinBroad.Name: Broad-Spectrum Antitoxin
AntitoxinBroad.Desc: An activated charcoal compound binding poisons in the stomach.
AntitoxinBroad.Effect: For 1 hour immune to Poisoned and poisons; does not cure poison already taken.

ClarityDrops.Name: Clarity Drops
ClarityDrops.Desc: Herbal drops clearing mental fog and sensory torpor.
ClarityDrops.Effect: +10 to Initiative and Perception for 2 hours. Removes Surprised.

DraughtOfPower.Name: Draught of Power
DraughtOfPower.Desc: A potent draught infused with pure aethyric power.
DraughtOfPower.Effect: Halves the CN of spells and rituals (minimum 1) for 2d10 rounds.

PotionOfInvisibility.Name: Potion of Invisibility
PotionOfInvisibility.Desc: Bends light around the drinker, rendering them completely invisible to mundane sight.
PotionOfInvisibility.Effect: Invisibility for 1d10 minutes. Attacks inflict Surprised condition, enemies without Second Sight suffer -3 SL.

PotionOfFlight.Name: Potion of Flight
PotionOfFlight.Desc: Invigorating draught infused with the essence of Azyr, lofting the drinker high into the sky.
PotionOfFlight.Effect: Grants the Flight (20) Creature Trait for 1d10 minutes.

ChannelpathPotion.Name: Channelpath Potion
ChannelpathPotion.Desc: Cleanses the aethyric conduits within a spellcaster, opening them to the currents of magic.
ChannelpathPotion.Effect: +2 SL to all Channelling Tests for 1d10 minutes.

PotionOfFortune.Name: Potion of Fortune
PotionOfFortune.Desc: Divinatory drops enabling the drinker to glimpse the tapestry of destiny and ward off ill fate.
PotionOfFortune.Effect: Restores 1 Fortune point or permits an Easy (+40) Augury Test.

NectarOfVitality.Name: Nectar of Vitality
NectarOfVitality.Desc: Life-giving elixir stimulating supernatural cellular healing and rapid muscle regeneration.
NectarOfVitality.Effect: Grants the Regenerate Creature Trait for 1d10 minutes.

Alkahest.Name: Alkahest (Universal Solvent)
Alkahest.Desc: The ultimate corrosive fluid dissolving stone, iron, and flesh.
Alkahest.Effect: Thrown: every target hit gains 2 + SL Ablaze Conditions (chemical burns). Eats through stone or steel.

CompassMeteoric.Name: Compass of Meteoric Silver
CompassMeteoric.Desc: Aethyric instrument that points directly to heavy magical concentrations, leyline nexuses, and artefacts.
CompassMeteoric.Effect: +2 SL to Navigation Tests when tracking sources of magic, storms of magic, and fulcrums.

LeonardoPowder.Name: Leonardo's Alchemical Powder
LeonardoPowder.Desc: An advanced explosive gunpowder igniting upon contact with air.
LeonardoPowder.Effect: Increases firearm/bomb Damage by +2 and grants Penetrating quality.

PotencyDraught.Name: Potency Draught
PotencyDraught.Desc: A concentrated bull root extract granting immense physical power.

LucidityTonic.Name: Lucidity Tonic
LucidityTonic.Desc: A potent stimulant banishing exhaustion and sluggishness.
LucidityTonic.Effect: +1 SL to Intelligence and Willpower Tests for 3d10 hours; afterwards 3 Fatigued Conditions.

DebauchFriend.Name: Debauch's Friend
DebauchFriend.Desc: An indispensable companion for tavern frequenters — fends off intoxication and morning hangovers.
DebauchFriend.Effect: Automatically passes all Consume Alcohol Tests for 1d10 hours.

NectarOfBeauty.Name: Nectar of Beauty
NectarOfBeauty.Desc: Fades blemishes, smooths imperfections, and endows the drinker with alluring symmetry.
NectarOfBeauty.Effect: +10 to Fellowship (+1 SL) on tests with characters susceptible to the drinker's charm for 3d10 hours.

NectarOfVeracity.Name: Nectar of Veracity
NectarOfVeracity.Desc: Evokes an irresistible compulsion to utter nothing but the unvarnished truth.
NectarOfVeracity.Effect: Drinker must pass a Hard (-20) Cool Test to speak a deliberate falsehood for 3d10 hours.

HairTonic.Name: Hair Tonic
HairTonic.Desc: A cosmetic scalp tonic stimulating rapid hair and beard growth.
HairTonic.Effect: Causes rapid growth of luxurious hair or beard within 24 hours.

PanaceaUniversalis.Name: Panacea Universalis
PanaceaUniversalis.Desc: The legendary herbal panacea curing all natural poisons and diseases.
PanaceaUniversalis.Effect: Heals 3×TB Wounds, removes all Bleeding and Fatigued Conditions; Critical Wounds – Winds of Magic table (GM).

BoarsMusk.Name: Boar's Musk
BoarsMusk.Desc: A repulsive musk extract sickening opponents in melee.
BoarsMusk.Effect: −2 SL to Fellowship and Dexterity Tests and the Distracting Trait (affects everyone nearby) for 1d10 hours.

HealingDraughtCore.Name: Healing Draught
HealingDraughtCore.Desc: Standard medicinal brew concocted by certified apothecaries and battlefield surgeons.
HealingDraughtCore.Effect: Immediately restores a number of Wounds equal to Toughness Bonus (TB).

VitalityDraughtCore.Name: Vitality Draught
VitalityDraughtCore.Desc: Invigorating draught of restorative herbs and spirits that shakes off weariness and toil.

DigestiveTonicCore.Name: Digestive Tonic
DigestiveTonicCore.Desc: Bitter herbal tonic soothing gut rot, bellyache, and toxic indigestion.
DigestiveTonicCore.Effect: Clears Poisoned condition and grants +20 against gastrointestinal ailments.

Channelpath.Name: Channelpath Potion
Channelpath.Desc: A decoction easing the safe and focused flow of the Winds of Magic.
Channelpath.Effect: +2 SL to all successful Channelling tests for 10 minutes.

Flight.Name: Potion of Flight
Flight.Desc: A mystical nectar granting aerial levitation through force of will.

Fortune.Name: Potion of Fortune
Fortune.Desc: An extract of rare herbs bending the strands of fate.

Invisibility.Name: Potion of Invisibility
Invisibility.Desc: An extraordinary draft bending light and masking the drinker's presence.
Invisibility.Effect: Invisible for 1d10 minutes: mundane senses cannot see you (you can still be heard), Second Sight at −2 SL; targets you attack become Surprised.

NectarVitality.Name: Nectar of Vitality
NectarVitality.Desc: A rich golden draught stimulating rapid cell repair.
NectarVitality.Effect: Regeneration for 1d10 minutes: in combat 1 Wound at the start of each round, out of combat Wounds return over the whole duration.

AqshyLiquidFire.Name: Liquid Flame of Aqshy
AqshyLiquidFire.Desc: A thrown phial containing the condensed heat of the Red Wind.
AqshyLiquidFire.Effect: Thrown like an Incendiary, but magical: every target hit gains 2 + SL Ablaze Conditions.

AqshyBlazingHeart.Name: Draught of the Blazing Heart
AqshyBlazingHeart.Desc: A fiery potion boiling the drinker's blood with battle fury.
AqshyBlazingHeart.Effect: +10 WS, +10 S and the Frenzy Trait for 10 minutes.

AqshyWeaponOil.Name: Flaming Weapon Oil
AqshyWeaponOil.Desc: An ointment infused with Aqshy sulfur, igniting blades on impact.
AqshyWeaponOil.Effect: The weapon burns for 1 hour: a hit inflicts 1 Ablaze Condition (GM adjudicates).

AqshyWarBlood.Name: Aqshy War Blood
AqshyWarBlood.Desc: A searing draught eradicating fear and hesitation.
AqshyWarBlood.Effect: +20 I and +10 WP for 10 minutes; immune to Fear (GM adjudicates).

AzyrStarlight.Name: Starlight Phial
AzyrStarlight.Desc: A crystalline fluid illuminating sight with celestial blue light.
AzyrStarlight.Effect: Night Vision and Second Sight Talents for 1 hour.

AzyrAstromancerSight.Name: Astromancer's Draught
AzyrAstromancerSight.Desc: An astromancer brew giving glimpses of incoming blows.
AzyrAstromancerSight.Effect: +20 I, +10 Ag and cannot be Surprised for 10 minutes.

AzyrLightningReflex.Name: Lightning Reflex Draught
AzyrLightningReflex.Desc: A lightning-infused draught accelerating muscle response.

AzyrStormTonic.Name: Azyr Storm Tonic
AzyrStormTonic.Desc: A refreshing tonic shielding nerves against electrical shock.

MeteoricCompass.Name: Compass of Meteoric Silver
MeteoricCompass.Desc: A navigational tool pointing toward the nearest magical concentration.
MeteoricCompass.Effect: Detects magic within 8 km. Grants +2 SL to magical tracking tests.

PowerPrism.Name: Power Prism
PowerPrism.Desc: A faceted aethyric prism isolating and refracting the Winds of Magic.
PowerPrism.Effect: Allows filtering aethyr or altering wind availability (WoM p. 160).

GhyranSpringDew.Name: Dew of the Spring Bough
GhyranSpringDew.Desc: Sacred dew mending the most devastating trauma and amputation.
GhyranSpringDew.Effect: Heals 3×TB Wounds and removes all Bleeding Conditions. One healing potion per encounter.

GhyranVitalSap.Name: Vital Sap Draught
GhyranVitalSap.Desc: Ancient oak sap infusing the body with natural vigor.
GhyranVitalSap.Effect: +10 Toughness for 1 hour; in combat 1 Wound at the start of each round.

GhyranBloodPurifier.Name: Ghyran Cleansing Draught
GhyranBloodPurifier.Desc: An herbal infusion purging toxins and plagues from the bloodstream.

GhyranIronbarkSalve.Name: Balsam of Ironbark
GhyranIronbarkSalve.Desc: A salve endowing skin with the durability of iron oak bark.
GhyranIronbarkSalve.Effect: +1 AP on all locations (stacks with armour) for 1 hour.

GhurPredatorSight.Name: Predator's Draught
GhurPredatorSight.Desc: A concoction bestowing the heightened senses of a timber wolf.
GhurPredatorSight.Effect: Night Vision and Acute Sense (Smell) Talents for 1 hour.

GhurUrsineVigor.Name: Ursine Vigor
GhurUrsineVigor.Desc: A surge of primeval strength from a cave bear claw.

GhurPrimalRoar.Name: Primal Roar Tonic
GhurPrimalRoar.Desc: A tonic awakening savage instincts and predatory attacks.
GhurPrimalRoar.Effect: +10 WS and the Fear (1) Trait for 10 minutes.

GhurSavageSalve.Name: Savage Pheromone Salve
GhurSavageSalve.Desc: A pheromone grease pacifying wild beasts.
GhurSavageSalve.Effect: +10 to animal-related Tests (care, training, riding, charming) for 4 hours.

HyshRadiantPurity.Name: Elixir of Radiant Purity
HyshRadiantPurity.Desc: A sacred fluid cleansing corruption and dark blight from the soul.
HyshRadiantPurity.Effect: Removes 1 Corruption point – at most once per week per character.

HyshSunsWrath.Name: Phial of Sun's Wrath
HyshSunsWrath.Desc: A thrown phial bursting into radiant sunlight.
HyshSunsWrath.Effect: Thrown: every target hit gains 1 + SL Blinded Conditions; Daemons and Undead suffer extra Damage at the GM's discretion.

HyshLucidityDraught.Name: Hysh Lucidity Draught
HyshLucidityDraught.Desc: A crystalline draught rendering the mind immune to shadows and deceit.

HyshTruthDrops.Name: Drops of Absolute Truth
HyshTruthDrops.Desc: Essence of truth discerning all deceit and falsehood.

ShyishPaleMask.Name: Draught of the Pale Mask
ShyishPaleMask.Desc: A draft halting pulse and breath into a state of suspended animation.
ShyishPaleMask.Effect: Feigned death for 1d10 hours: immune to poisons, diseases and mind magic (GM adjudicates).

ShyishSpiritBane.Name: Grave Oil / Spirit Bane
ShyishSpiritBane.Desc: A weapon coating slaying incorporeal spirits and wraiths.
ShyishSpiritBane.Effect: Weapon strikes as magical and deals +3 damage against undead for 1 hour.

ShyishHourglass.Name: Hourglass Decoction
ShyishHourglass.Desc: A mystical fluid staying the final sand in the glass of death.
ShyishHourglass.Effect: For 1 hour: when Wounds drop to 0, the character survives once with 1 Wound (GM adjudicates).

ShyishShroud.Name: Shyish Shroud
ShyishShroud.Desc: A brew wreathing the drinker in the dreadful chill of the grave.
ShyishShroud.Effect: +10 Willpower and the Fear (1) Trait for 1 hour.

UlguShadowMist.Name: Shadow Mist Draught
UlguShadowMist.Desc: A phial shattered on the ground creating a cloud of impenetrable shadow.
UlguShadowMist.Effect: Creates 6 m radius shadow fog for 1d10 rounds (total concealment).

UlguPhantasmagoria.Name: Phantasmagoria Elixir
UlguPhantasmagoria.Desc: An illusory draught shifting facial features, voice, and aura.
UlguPhantasmagoria.Effect: +20 to Charm and Entertain Tests (disguise, deceit) for 1d10 hours.

UlguStalkerOil.Name: Stalker's Oil
UlguStalkerOil.Desc: A silence grease muffling footsteps and armor clatter.

UlguWraithstep.Name: Wraithstep Draught
UlguWraithstep.Desc: A shadowy draught rendering the physical body semi-incorporeal.
UlguWraithstep.Effect: Allows passing through grates, doors, and bars for 1d10 rounds.

FlashPowder.Name: Alchemical Flash Powder
FlashPowder.Desc: An explosive pyrotechnic blend producing a brilliant flash of light.
FlashPowder.Effect: Blinds all creatures within 3 meters for 1 round.

QuickGlue.Name: Quick-Drying Glue
QuickGlue.Desc: A viscous resin adhesive curing in seconds.
QuickGlue.Effect: Instantly bonds stone, wood, and metal; can immobilize enemy boots.

DebauchsFriend.Name: Debauch's Friend
DebauchsFriend.Desc: An herbal decoction shielding liver and head from inebriation.
DebauchsFriend.Effect: Automatically pass Consume Alcohol Tests for 1d10 hours.

NectarBeauty.Name: Nectar of Beauty
NectarBeauty.Desc: A tonic smoothing the skin and bestowing captivating radiance.
NectarBeauty.Effect: +1 SL to Fellowship Tests against those attracted to the drinker, for 3d10 hours (toggle in the test dialog).

NectarVeracity.Name: Nectar of Veracity
NectarVeracity.Desc: A root extract preventing conscious falsehoods.
NectarVeracity.Effect: To lie, the drinker must pass a Hard (−20) Cool Test – for 3d10 hours (GM adjudicates).

Forgetfulness.Name: Draught of Forgetfulness
Forgetfulness.Desc: A concoction wiping recent memories from the drinker's mind.
Forgetfulness.Effect: Erases memories of the last 24 hours (WP -10 to resist).

SoothingDraught.Name: Soothing Draught
SoothingDraught.Desc: A calming draught soothing agitated nerves and anger.
SoothingDraught.Effect: +10 Willpower, but −10 Agility, Initiative and Intelligence for 1d10×10 minutes.

HealingDraught.Name: Healing Draught
HealingDraught.Desc: A standard comfrey extract healing lacerations and wounds.
HealingDraught.Effect: Heals TB Wounds if the character has more than 0 Wounds. One dose per encounter.

MasterworkHealing.Name: Masterwork Healing Draught
MasterworkHealing.Desc: An expertly distilled restorative of exceptional mending power.
MasterworkHealing.Effect: Average (+20) Cool Test to swallow it; then 1 Fatigued Condition. Otherwise it does nothing – a placebo.

VitalityDraught.Name: Vitality Draught
VitalityDraught.Desc: A fresh sage draught expelling physical fatigue.

DigestiveTonic.Name: Digestive Tonic
DigestiveTonic.Desc: A peppermint distillate calming indigestion and sour stomach.
DigestiveTonic.Effect: +20 to recovery Tests against stomach ailments (e.g. the Bloody Flux) for 1 day.

MundanePanacea.Name: Mundane Panacea
MundanePanacea.Desc: A comprehensive herbal compound fighting wound infections.
MundanePanacea.Effect: Removes all Bleeding and Poisoned Conditions (does not heal Wounds).

SoulBalm.Name: Soul Balm
SoulBalm.Desc: An extraordinary salve calming traumatized spirits.
SoulBalm.Effect: +20 to Willpower Tests against Fear, Terror and Intimidation for 6 hours (toggle in the test dialog).

TrollrootTincture.Name: Trollroot Tincture
TrollrootTincture.Desc: A vigorous tincture drastically accelerating bone knitting.
TrollrootTincture.Effect: Doubles natural healing rate and halves fracture recovery time.

SkavenBrew.Name: Warpstone Draught
SkavenBrew.Desc: A vile Clan Moulder draught infused with raw warpstone.
SkavenBrew.Effect: +30 Strength and +30 Toughness for 2d10 − TB rounds; then a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test – on failure Poisoned and Bleeding (−6 SL: also Ablaze).

ReactionaryRestorative.Name: Reactionary Restorative
ReactionaryRestorative.Desc: A pungent, ginger draught stimulating the nervous system for swift defensive reactions and counterattacks.
ReactionaryRestorative.Effect: Cannot be Surprised for 1d10 hours; afterwards 1 Fatigued Condition.

FocusingPhiltre.Name: Focusing Philtre
FocusingPhiltre.Desc: A clear brew of Silver Lotus and crystalline water sharpening perception and analytical faculties.
FocusingPhiltre.Effect: +20 to Intelligence and Endurance Tests for 1d10 hours; afterwards 1 Fatigued Condition.

TonicSight.Name: Tonic of Sight Beyond Sight
TonicSight.Desc: A luminous elixir allowing one to perceive that which is concealed from mortal eyes.
TonicSight.Effect: A random Talent for 1d10 minutes (1d10): 1–2 Acute Sense (Sight), 3–4 Holy Visions, 5–6 Detect Magic, 7–8 Second Sight, 9–10 all of them.

CordeliaRestorative.Name: Cordelia's Enhanced Restorative Tonic
CordeliaRestorative.Desc: An exceptional alchemical tonic created by the brilliant physician Cordelia Welscher of Ubersreik.
CordeliaRestorative.Effect: Heals 2×TB Wounds; Difficult (−10) Endurance Test – on failure a side effect (Blinded, Broken, Stunned or Unconscious) for as many minutes as the SL of failure.

TrollAcid.Name: Troll Acid
TrollAcid.Desc: A corrosive secretion harvested from a troll stomach, dissolving metal and organic armour alike.
TrollAcid.Effect: Thrown: Damage +9 + SL (Penetrating, Dangerous); eats through up to 8 Enc of equipment.

VeinPowder.Name: Veinpowder
